design.css: .x-design { width: 1080px; height: 1350px; position: relative; background-color: #ffffff; overflow: hidden; } .x-card { position: absolute; inset: 0; padding: 170px 80px 90px 80px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-sizing: border-box; } .x-expr { font-size: 145px; font-weight: 900; color: #222; background-color: #fff; padding: 20px 40px; border: 8px solid #222; border-radius: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px; box-shadow: 15px 15px 0px #ff8787; } .x-roman { font-size: 55px; color: #444; background-color: #f1f3f5; padding: 10px 30px; border-radius: 50px; margin-bottom: 50px; } .x-text-main { font-size: 68px; font-weight: 700; color: #111; text-align: center; word-break: keep-all; line-height: 1.4; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); padding: 20px; border-radius: 15px; } .x-text-sub { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 600; color: #222; text-align: center; word-break: keep-all; line-height: 1.5; background-color: #ffffff; padding: 40px; border-radius: 25px; border: 5px dashed #adb5bd; } .x-bg-1 { background-color: #e3fafc; } .x-bg-2 { background-color: #fff0f6; } .x-bg-3 { background-color: #f3f0ff; } .x-bg-4 { background-color: #e7f5ff; } .x-bg-5 { background-color: #ebfbee; } .x-bg-6 { background-color: #fff4e6; } .x-shape { position: absolute; z-index: -1; } .x-circle { width: 400px; height: 400px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffc9c9; top: 200px; right: -100px; opacity: 0.5; } .x-stripe { width: 120%; height: 100px; background: #d0ebff; transform: rotate(-5deg); position: absolute; top: 400px; left: -10%; } .x-dots { width: 200px; height: 200px; background-image: radial-gradient(#ced4da 20%, transparent 20%); background-size: 30px 30px; top: 200px; left: 50px; } .x-emoji { font-size: 100px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
